facts.note: At the temple's nine, everyone showed watches. Ruedi's was exact, the doctor's two minutes ahead, and Girard would not take his out.
Hall clock struck ten while the regulator showed twelve minutes to ten. When the temple struck ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
Master sent her down when the regulator showed twenty past ten; regulator was running and he was well; she went straight to the kitchen.
That afternoon she saw the master in the kitchen with Rosa's clock in his hands, laughing; she did not ask why.
Looking at Rosa's clock when Madame's piano began: two minutes to eleven. When the piano stopped: eleven minutes past eleven.
She stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven. Wording is split across two answers but the content matches.
